title: Academic Writing — Preparing a seed bank
description: Academic Task 1 visual report and Task 2 essay. Suggested time: 60 minutes.

tasks.prompt:
The diagram shows how seed samples are prepared for long-term storage in a conservation seed bank.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

items.label: Collect
items.detail: Mature seeds are gathered in the field.

items.label: Register
items.detail: Each sample receives a location record and identification code.

items.label: Clean
items.detail: Damaged seeds and plant fragments are removed.

items.label: Dry
items.detail: Seeds are dried in a room with controlled humidity.

items.label: Package
items.detail: Dried seeds are sealed in labelled containers.

items.label: Store and check
items.detail: Samples are frozen and selected seeds are tested periodically.

tasks.prompt:
Should public funding prioritise conserving a wide variety of plants or improving a smaller number of commercially useful crops? Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples.

Write at least 250 words.
